prompt: I need to add dark mode to our React app. It uses Tailwind CSS and we want users to toggle between light and dark themes. Let's plan this.

assertions.text: PLAN.md file exists at the output path
Plan contains a '## Goal' section with a one-sentence goal statement
Plan contains a '## Files' section listing specific file paths
Plan contains at least 3 numbered implementation steps
Plan mentions Tailwind's darkMode config (e.g. 'class' strategy in tailwind.config)
Plan addresses theme persistence (e.g. localStorage or similar)
Plan contains a '## Edge Cases' section
